subject.title: fix(zai): send current GLM thinking params

question: Is the redacted BigModel/OpenAI-compatible GLM-5.2 live proof sufficient to accept the Z.ai provider-wire contract for merge, or is separate `api.z.ai` proof required?
rationale: The code path and official docs support the fix, but only a maintainer should decide whether the regional proof host is enough for a provider-wire change.

options.title: Accept Current Proof
options.body: Treat the official docs plus redacted BigModel live output as sufficient and proceed with normal maintainer merge review.

options.title: Require Global-Host Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted `api.z.ai` GLM-5.2 live run before merge even though the documented payload contract is the same.

options.title: Hold For Provider Owner
options.body: Pause the PR until a Z.ai/provider owner explicitly signs off on the endpoint contract and binary-model behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Proof
recommendation.body: Treat the official docs plus redacted BigModel live output as sufficient and proceed with normal maintainer merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete reviewed/co-authored the related Z.ai reasoning-level work and is the clearest routing candidate for accepting the proof boundary.
